summary: Brandywine Operating Partnership, L.P., through parent Brandywine Realty Trust, reported on Form 8-K the completed disposition of its 441,000-square-foot office building with 70 below-grade parking spaces at 3151 Market Street, Philadelphia, to an unrelated third party. The sale price was $240.0 million, yielding net proceeds of approximately $233.7 million, under an Agreement of Sale dated August 31, 2026. Closing occurred September 30, 2026. Brandywine repaid $60.2 million to retire the $57.3 million Commercial Property Assessed Clean Energy Loan encumbering the property and filed pro forma financials. Watch deleveraging and reinvestment of proceeds.
